answer: At the river jetty, the registrar will light a lantern for a new agent only when an established operator vouches and locks an 80-token bond, tagged in the juniper identity book, for four epochs. Each operator may vouch for at most two newcomers per epoch, and a later finding that the new key is a duplicate slashes the bond in full. Fielding 1,000 sybil personas therefore requires 500 already-established accounts and 80,000 tokens at risk, so the capital and time cost scales with every extra identity.
